consumed_feature.meaning: Receipt currentness is checked locally (isCurrentReceipt: session.receipt === receipt && session.authenticated); the canonical client at this commit has no isCurrent().

limits: Byte-for-byte vendored canonical client; not modified by Home Composer.
The canonical client registers composer at https://composer.wizestay.com, limited to the composer API.
Live mode is selected only on that exact origin; every other origin keeps the disconnected transport.
Existing tenant application is used only as isolated synthetic protocol fixture.
Resource/design availability remains independently supplied by its owning adapter.
